title: Morning Trading Plan

sections.title: Mindset Check
items: Stay Disciplined: Follow your plan, no emotional trades.
Accept Risk: Losses are part of the game; focus on execution.
Focus on Process: Winning comes from consistency, not shortcuts.

sections.title: Market Overview
items: Check global markets and major indices (Dow, S&P 500, SGX Nifty).
Review any relevant news/events (economic data, earnings).
Analyze pre-market sentiment (gap up, gap down, flat open).

sections.title: Technical Analysis
items: Note previous day’s high/low and pivot points.

sections.title: Strategy Checklist
items: Define Your Trade: Index (Bank Nifty/Nifty), Trade Type (Call/Put).
Entry Criteria: Enter near support or resistance breaks with confirmation.
Exit Criteria: Predefined profit target and stop-loss.

sections.title: Risk Management
items: Daily loss limit: Stop trading after 2-3 failed trades.
Limit trades: Stick to 2-3 quality trades only.
Position sizing: Calculate lot size based on capital and risk.

sections.title: Execution Rules
items: Avoid trading in the first 15 minutes unless a setup is clear.
Use alerts for levels, don’t overanalyze.

sections.title: End-of-Day Reflection
items: Commit to journaling every trade (entry, exit, reasoning).

motivationalReminder: Discipline and patience are your edge. Execute the plan, and the profits will follow.
